topics.title: Seatbelts, Rehab, and Floating Penis
topics.summary: A caller discusses seatbelt habits and head injury concerns while expressing skepticism about Robert Downey Jr.’s rehab efforts. The conversation shifts to a lawsuit involving a paralyzed teen due to an improperly fitted lap belt, followed by news of Tommy Lee’s jail time and plans for a Vegas movie shoot; finally, the program reports finding Sammy ‘the Bull’s penis floating in a river with a red ribbon tied around it.

topics.title: Drunken Arguments and Absurdities
topics.summary: Howard argues with Robin about a past disagreement, fueled by alcohol and misinterpretations regarding his new TV show featuring nudity and lesbians. He then discusses action movies, Bruce Willis’s performance in ‘Armageddon,’ and bizarre topics like the hand jive and a troubled teenager's prison record, while Jackie offers commentary.

topics.title: Unscripted Confessional
topics.summary: A chaotic and meandering conversation unfolds between hosts and a guest, filled with bizarre anecdotes including dogs humping legs and drug use, misinterpretations of events, and an improvised song featuring nonsensical lyrics. The discussion veers wildly from personal details to random observations culminating in the creation of 'Barbarella'.

topics.title: Radio Chaos & Rock Hall Expansion
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard discusses Ellen DeGeneres’ show cancellation by ABC while simultaneously covering the opening of the expanded Rock and Roll Hall of Fame exhibit in Cleveland. He expresses frustration with television support, details an interaction involving Gary Oldman at the Hall of Fame (focused on a spaghetti strainer), covers Mayor Giuliani's feud with David Dinkins before discussing Scott Weiland’s claim that Stone Temple Pilots are still together.

topics.title: Radio Show Mishap & Baseball Dreams
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss Neil Jordan’s film *The Butcher Boy* featuring Sinead O’Connor as the Virgin Mary. They then delve into Howard Stern discussing his upcoming TV show and Michael Schmidt's baseball career before abruptly ending their conversation with chaotic banter about various topics including television shows, sports figures, and personal anecdotes.
